transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, September 11. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Why iPhones are so expensive in India again. Apple's new iPhones cost more this year, not just the Duo, its first foldable, or the 18 Pro. Older models went up too, breaking a five-year run of steady pricing in India. Some of that is tax and currency. Most of it is a global memory shortage, squeezed by AI's appetite for chips. 'Literally as old as my career': Why Shami is impressed by Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Veteran fast bowler Mohammed Shami recently emphasised the importance of nurturing young Indian cricketers. He highlighted how the pressures of high-stakes tournaments have accelerated their development. Shami is dedicated to offering strategic insights during tough matches. He also reflected on his own drive to stay motivated, even while away from the national team and celebrated his career milestone by capturing the Duleep Trophy during his 100th first-class match. 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images. A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. Putin lands in Delhi for Brics Summit, to meet PM Modi today. NEW DELHI: Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in India on early Friday ahead of the Brics Summit 2026. Deadly plot by 'killer bahu': Kanpur bizman sensed danger, but ended up with 26 stab wounds. An alleged murder plot to stage a heart attack was foiled when the victim returned home. The intended suffocation plan changed to a violent stabbing after the victim discovered the attackers. The victim sustained 26 stab wounds during the assault which occurred late at night. The alleged conspirator was reportedly dancing at a lounge while the killing unfolded. India adds 30 new nuclear warheads, total at 190: US Study. News News: New Delhi: At least 30 additional nuclear warheads for new missiles under production have been added to India's 160 existing warheads for operational . 22-year-old pleads guilty in US' biggest Bitcoin theft; spent millions on cars and more. A 22-year-old organized a scheme stealing over 4,100 Bitcoin from an investor. The stolen cryptocurrency was then spent on luxury items and lavish experiences. Investigators traced the digital trail through a missed IP address, leading to arrests. Several defendants have pleaded guilty, and others are awaiting sentencing in the ongoing case. Modi-Xi meet: Trade, border on agenda during Xi's 24-hour blitz. China announced Thursday President Xi Jinping's first visit to India in 7 years, saying he will attend the Brics summit in New Delhi from September 12 to 13 at the invitation of PM Narendra Modi. 'Toxic' day 16: Yash film earns rupees 39 lakh, sees 35 percent drop. Yash's film 'Toxic' continues its theatrical run, earning rupees 39 lakhs on its sixteenth day. The movie's India net collection has now reached rupees 248.24 crore after its recent performance. Its worldwide gross collection has impressively climbed to rupees 339.79 crore. The Kannada version contributed more earnings than the Hindi version on day sixteen. Rare seahorse dad with newborns wins Ocean Photographer of the Year 2026. French photographer Julien Anton won the top prize at the Ocean Photographer of the Year 2026 awards. His winning image captured a male seahorse with two newborn juveniles in French Polynesia. Anton spent many hours searching for the rare seahorse family in Mo'orea. The photograph also won the Wildlife category before receiving the grand prize. UK red kite population soars 2,613 percent after reintroduction from near-extinction. Once teetering on the brink of extinction, the red kite has staged a stunning comeback in Britain. Thanks to reintroduction efforts that began in 1989, with birds transported from Spain and Sweden, their population has surged astronomically, surpassing a 2,600 percent increase since 1995. These magnificent raptors are now found across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, although conservationists remain vigilant against potential threats to their continued survival. iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max launched: Check India prices, availability. Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro models. The iPhone Duo features a large inner display and a smaller outer screen. iPhone 18 Pro models boast a new 48MP camera and extended battery life. All devices run on the powerful A20 Pro chip and offer eSIM-only functionality.
